faq.title: Frequently asked questions before launch
faq.desc: Answers to key questions before launch: solution format, pricing, and future scaling.

items.q: Is this a template or a custom development?
items.a: The core solution is ready, but each setup is adapted to a specific rental business: brand, structure, copy, content blocks, request flow and control panel.
The one-time setup is € 2500. Support starts from € 100 per month depending on the scope.

items.q: What is included in monthly support?
items.a: Technical support, small changes, stability monitoring, updates and help with the system after launch.

items.q: Can new features be added later?
items.a: Yes. The project is built to grow further: online payments, extra roles, integrations, multilingual support and other modules.

contact.title: I will show the demo, answer your questions and help adapt the system to your workflow.
